name: Argo Graphene Solutions Corp.
summary: Argo Graphene Solutions Corp. is primarily engaged in the agricultural production industry. This firm specializes in agribusiness, focusing on the creation and advancement of a variety of organic products. These offerings encompass soil amendments, living soils, bio-fertilizers, natural pesticides, fungicides, vermicompost, and kits for preparing compost tea. The company was established on March 14, 2018, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Vancouver, Canada.
